contributions.statement: Verify incremental code-index updates (symbol graph, embeddings) against a periodic full rebuild per repository, and do not treat a successful update job as evidence of a correct index; symbol-graph repair completed on every held-out change but matched a rebuild on only 13 of 24.
contributions.evidence: §9.5, §10.1 F4/F5: 13/24 symbol repair; vector reuse exact on 27/30 at ~40x speed; 8 repos in Go, Python, Rust, TS/JS (no Java).

contributions.statement: Serve symbol definitions from a precomputed static graph but route reference queries to a live language server, since static definitions matched live LSP on 86% of requests while references matched only 64% (C/C++ 23/75).
contributions.evidence: §9.4 Fig. 9, F3: 403/470 definitions matched, 1.23 s vs 6.35 s ready time; 311 of 487 mismatches traced to the authors' own decoder bug. Java/jdtls untested.

reason: Index-fidelity results are the robust part and bear directly on any code-graph constituent (e.g. Gortex) serving multiple repos; the end-to-end repair gain is fragile and excluded.
